target_shape:
ROOT is `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`: the main checkout, or a lane under .claude/worktrees/<name>. Every path in this list is relative to ROOT on purpose. A hard-coded absolute path to the main checkout is exactly the defect C3 removes: it sends worktree sessions into main.

How to execute:
- Work in one dedicated worktree off main, after the live command session has pushed.
- Before the first edit, copy this list into memory/ACTIVE_PLAN.md as its task table (the global rule for work over 2 phases).
- Group the work into about 20 commits so artifact-currency's 30-commit window does not go red partway through.
- Every change under scripts/ci or tests/gates carries a `Mutation-Proof:` trailer.
- Every archive move uses `opsec-scan --rekey` (D1), never `--write`.

Verified this turn, at main df2a10fa:
- AGENTS.md is 324 lines and 34,487 B.
- artifact-currency is red: sota-audit is 36 commits behind against a limit of 30, and main is 24 commits ahead of origin.
- In a lane, `git add -A --dry-run` stages the frontend/node_modules symlink (its target is the operator home path), and opsec-scan follows it with statSync.
- The tracked settings.json wires 5 graft hooks to an untracked helper, with timeouts of 8000-15000 seconds.
- The compaction hook emits on PostCompact. Context7 (anthropics/claude-code `ClassicResultFields`) shows additionalContext is accepted on SessionStart but not on PostCompact.
- The installed 2.1.311 binary contains CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR, .worktreeinclude, SessionEnd and prompt-audit. `onFailure: block` arrived in 2.1.295 (per the CHANGELOG).
- Load averages are 33-42.
- No 3D asset loader appears in src, and Blender is not installed.

Figures marked "lane-measured" come from the four audit lanes and were not re-run here.

THE HARNESS AFTER THE CHANGE

1. Always-loaded instructions. .agent/AGENTS.md drops from 324 lines / 34.5 KB to 200 lines or fewer / about 11 KB, about 45% generated. A root AGENTS.md symlink lets Codex read it too. Its sections:
   - Layout: ROOT from git, APP = ROOT/frontend, a tree that names STATUS, .claude/rules, ci/pipeline.sh and .githooks, and the rule to restate ROOT/APP in delegation briefs.
   - Stack: the MEASURED block, now including a generated line of package majors, plus 4 qualitative bullets.
   - Hard rules: each one names its enforcer.
   - Gates: the GATES table with compressed descriptions, rows for the e2e suite, visual and test:look, and 3 visual one-liners.
   - Process hygiene (3 bullets), the models/review override (2 lines), and where state lives: the auto-memory line, the path-scoped-rules line, and a 5-entry READ-ORDER.
   - Compaction & resume (about 0.7 KB) and a 1-line /loop pointer.
   - Removed: history narration, hand-typed counts, and stale model names.
2. Rules that fire when a matching file is touched: gates-and-probes.md becomes an 80-line checklist and its history moves to docs/superpowers/GATE-INCIDENTS.md; input-and-pointer-lock.md takes in the still-true movement checks; voxel-mesher.md is unchanged; a new physics.md of 20 lines or fewer holds only traps a model cannot derive. doc-currency checks their paths and harness-integrity checks their globs.
3. Deterministic layer. The tracked settings.json holds only repo-content wiring:
   - deny: cmux close-surface, git push --no-verify, git commit --amend;
   - env: CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR=1;
   - hooks: SessionStart(compact) orientation; a PreToolUse guard against in-place rewrites of frontend/src JS(X); a SessionEnd orphan sweep;
   - graft moves to settings.local.json plus .worktreeinclude;
   - the $schema is the schemastore Claude Code schema.
4. Gates:
   - pre-commit becomes a staged tier of 10 s or less (static gates plus `vitest related`, printing its denominator);
   - pre-push runs the full offline core once per pushed SHA in the existing detached worktree;
   - pipeline.sh scrubs GIT_* per step, and ESLint forbids raw git spawns in tests;
   - a harness-integrity test checks hooks, events, globs and denies;
   - opsec-scan scans a symlink by its blob;
   - `prepare` wires core.hooksPath on every install;
   - commit-msg chains the attribution guard.
5. Docs:
   - Canonical: AGENTS; ACTIVE_PLAN (one cursor, size-capped by doc-currency); STATUS (a registry of 30 KB or less with ▢/▣✓/⊘ markers, the one list of Kevin-only items, and a pointer to the active campaign plan); INDEX (every doc mapped, gated); DECISIONS (generated TOC); a rewritten ARCHITECTURE; README; SOTA-INITIATIVE (vision and guardrails only).
   - Records: CHANGELOG (current quarter, older quarters in memory/archive), the OVERNIGHT brief, plans and specs with gated status banners, and the campaign folders.
   - Archive: docs/archive/<quarter>/ and memory/archive/, moved with git mv.
   - Orientation reading drops from about 492 KB (lane-measured) to about 80 KB.
6. Future-proofing loop:
   - Cut everything a model can derive.
   - Make every never-do a permission or a hook.
   - Gate every harness file.
   - After each model upgrade, run `/doctor prompt-audit`, cut or restore one section at a time, and restore a section only when its failure recurs.
   - Record each pass in DECISIONS.

changes.change: Add `--rekey`: it reads the renames from `git diff --cached --name-status -M`, moves each ledger count to the new path, and refuses if `_total` would rise. Every archive commit uses it instead of `--write`.
changes.why: The ledger is keyed by path (_total 423, verified). A moved file's existing debt therefore blocks the commit, and the only regeneration path, --write, would silently absorb any new debt added in the same commit.

not_doing: Not installing Blender: nothing consumes authored 3D assets today. A grep of frontend/src for useGLTF, GLTFLoader, .glb, .gltf, useTexture and TextureLoader returned 0 hits this turn; textures are procedural, and Blender is not installed. A system package also needs Kevin's explicit OK under the global rules. If the masterpiece design panel picks hand-made models, prefer MagicaVoxel .vox fed to the existing greedy mesher, and use headless Blender plus gltf-transform only for glTF baking.

No project skills (.claude/skills/prove-in-game, lookbook, mutation-batch). The global scope rule puts new skills only in AB skills/<name>-kz/. The instruments ship as scripts with one-line pointers (E1, E2), and the procedure lives in the trimmed gates-and-probes.md rule.

No project .claude/agents overrides that pin reviewers at xhigh. That has the same scope conflict, and the repo is public. xhigh is set per Workflow stage, per DECISIONS 2026-10-27. Proposing a per-project effort override is a message to the AB owner, not a Crafty edit.

Not moving the GATES table out of AGENTS.md into a path-scoped rule. Which tier runs which gate is what an agent needs when a hook goes red, so it is compressed in place (C1). Revisit only through the prompt-audit cut-and-restore loop.

Not retiring the era-review and sota-audit pages or the artifact-currency gate. Kevin asked for that check after three stale-page incidents, so they are regenerated instead; only the dormant loop-progress surface and the uncited KEVIN-REVIEW.html are retired.
Not keying green-tree receipts by tree SHA. B7 stops pre-commit writing receipts, so cross-lane receipt eviction stops mattering.
Not upgrading graft (0.13 to 0.26) or uninstalling it. That is a global npm install and a call on operator tooling; graft only becomes machine-local (A5).

Not editing Agentic-Brain files. These go to the AB owner by message: naming the Antigravity .agent/workflows channel loss in configs/known-gaps.json; dropping /.githooks/commit-msg from the attribution-guard installer's ignore block; and the reviewer-effort override.

Not purging operator paths, the raw audit JSONs, or the hostname embedded in memory/perf/*.json filenames from public git history. Rewriting pushed history is one of Kevin's two bright lines. Deleting from HEAD only lowers ongoing debt; the hostname exposure is a separate decision for Kevin.

Not fixing the CI e2e shard time limit: main's latest ci.yml run is 'cancelled' (shards 2 and 3 at the limit, per DECISIONS 2026-10-27). That belongs to the command session's task list, and the read order ranks a red CI above this reorg.
No formal before/after task-success ablation across fixed tasks: no instrument exists for it here. Byte and line sizes plus `/doctor prompt-audit` and restore-on-recurrence stand in for it.
No gate on how many days since STATUS or CHANGELOG was last touched: touching the file would satisfy it. D7's plan-status check covers the completion step instead.
Not reordering old DECISIONS entries, which would churn blame; the generated TOC (D11) carries the order.
No `onFailure: block` on the new PreToolUse guard. A bug in it would block every Bash call, so it fails open and harness-integrity checks its wiring.
Not moving the sota-2026-09 folder: about 72 files cite its Q ids (lane-measured). It gets CLOSED banners instead (D5).
